summary: The Dallas dossiers match the CURRENT FACTS on coach, front office, 26-56, the Cup group, trade moves and the Specter exclusion. They had four patterns of error. Dallas's opener was assumed to be Oct 20. The Cup cadence was overstated: Dallas plays four group games, not five Fridays. The State Fair was said to overlap the opening weeks. And footwear hooks ignored that Flagg (New Balance) and Irving (Anta) sit outside Nike. Smaller fixes: Badu's hometown, Jim Jackson, the Kessler location, the Mavs Ball and Mavs Ballers vocabulary, and the removal of Sweet Georgia Brown. Live checks confirmed Trees and Kettle Art. The strategy brief still needs edits on the Cup cadence and opener date. The City Edition history, door-level retail and small-venue status remain unverified.
